meta.name: video-enhancement
meta.description: Upscale, restore, denoise, interpolate and edit existing videos via inference.sh CLI. Models: Topaz Proteus, Starlight, Astra, Nyx denoise, Apollo/Chronos/Aion frame interpolation, Themis deblur, colorization, Hyperion SDR to HDR, RIFE, Bria video upscale, background removal, green screen, background replacement, video eraser, Pruna P-Video-Upscale. Use for: upscale video to 1080p/4K/8K, restore old or compressed footage, deinterlace, remove noise and grain, slow motion, 60fps conversion, colorize black and white video, remove or replace video background, erase objects from video. Triggers: video upscale, upscale video, video upscaler, 4k video, enhance video, video enhancement, restore video, topaz video, topaz video ai, proteus, starlight, astra, denoise video, video noise reduction, deinterlace, frame interpolation, slow motion, increase fps, 60fps, rife, colorize video, sdr to hdr, deblur video, video background removal, green screen video, replace video background, video eraser
